1.explanation: This snippet mounts a plain Carbon DataTable with no custom row‐height styling. By inspecting the header (`<th>`) and row (`<tr>`) elements in DevTools you will see their computed heights come from the existing DataTable stylesheet (48px for the header, 32px for rows). There is currently no `size` prop or CSS variant in the DataTable component for the new “md” (40px / 2.5rem) row height, which reproduces the bug described in the ticket.
1.bug_scenario: The default DataTable renders its header and body rows at the existing fixed heights (3 rem/48 px for the header, 2 rem/32 px for each body row), but the design specification calls for a new “md” size variant at 2.5 rem/40 px. In other words, there is no way today to render a 40 px–tall row or header in the DataTable; it always falls back to the existing sizes.
